155e54a2f442c6f28706.source: ;const decode=s=>Uint8Array.from(atob(s),c=>c.charCodeAt(0));function node(tag,text,parent){const e=document.createElement(tag);e.textContent=text;parent.append(e);return e}function show(data){const root=document.getElementById('content');root.replaceChildren();node('h1',data.name,root);for(const scene of data.scenes){const section=node('section','',root);node('h2',scene.name,section);for(const group of scene.groups){const article=node('article','',section);node('h3',group.name,article);for(const item of group.items){let url;try{url=new URL(item[1]);if(!['https:','http:'].includes(url.protocol))continue}catch{continue}const a=node('a',item[0],article);a.href=url.href;a.target='_blank';a.rel='noopener noreferrer';node('small',item[2]||url.hostname,a)}}}document.getElementById('unlock').hidden=true}if(!payload.encrypted)show(JSON.parse(new TextDecoder().decode(decode(payload.data))));else{const form=document.getElementById('unlock');form.hidden=false;form.onsubmit=async e=>{e.preventDefault();try{const base=await crypto.subtle.importKey('raw',new TextEncoder().encode(form.querySelector('input').value),'PBKDF2',false,['deriveKey']);const key=await crypto.subtle.deriveKey({name:'PBKDF2',salt:decode(payload.salt),iterations:250000,hash:'SHA-256'},base,{name:'AES-GCM',length:256},false,['decrypt']);const plain=await crypto.subtle.decrypt({name:'AES-GCM',iv:decode(payload.iv)},key,decode(payload.data));show(JSON.parse(new TextDecoder().decode(plain)))}catch{document.getElementById('error').textContent='密码不正确，或浏览器不支持打开加密网页。'}}}

我的理解：把大目标拆成今天能完成的一小步。

Save a favorite line with its source and your thoughts, ready for writing or sharing.

My thought: break a big goal into one small step I can take today.

Draft messages, emails or social posts here. Refine them before copying them out.

For example: Hi everyone, Friday's project meeting is now at 3 pm. Please prepare any questions and reply to confirm. Thanks!

en.text:
Summarize methods and key facts in your own words for later review.

For example: after reading an article, note its main idea, add a practical example and list any questions you still have.

en.text:
Discard old drafts, temporary notes or ideas you've set aside.

Select “Discard” to move a note to the bin. Click a paper ball to read it, then “Restore” to edit it in Notes again.

Use “Empty bin” to clear what you no longer need. Once confirmed, this cannot be undone.

归档后，内容会从日常小记中收起，集中保存在“已归档”里，方便以后查阅和复用。这样，小记里可以专注保留正在使用、还需要修改的内容。

Your content stays safe. Restore it whenever you want to edit again.

1f99f6c5c668ac06e877.source:

点击小记上的“丢弃”，内容会进入垃圾桶。点击纸团可以展开查看；需要继续使用时，点击“捡回来”，回到“我的小记”后就能编辑。

确认不再需要的内容，可以通过“倾倒垃圾桶”清理。确认倾倒后无法恢复。
